options.text: Enough lime water mixed with the lemon juice to form a solution that is neither acidic nor basic.
One drop of lime water is enough to neutralise any amount of lemon juice.
Adding enough plain water alone made the lemon juice neither acidic nor basic.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Inaya starts with lemon juice that turns blue litmus red. She adds lime water a little at a time until the mixture is neither acidic nor basic. She also has plain water.

part_answers.answer: Neutralisation needs sufficient acid and base together; one drop or plain water alone is not enough.

teacher.key_rationale: Neutralisation is sufficient mixing of acid and base to give a neither-acidic-nor-basic solution.
